# Introduction
Calculation of *total number of genes with regionally elevated expression* in the **forebrain**. The forebrain consists of:

* cerebral cortex
* basal ganglia
* thalamus
* hypothalamus

This calculation will analyse data from human, pig and mouse brains.

## Human brain
```{r}
human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(human)
```

## Pig brain
```{r}
pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(pig)
```

## Mouse
```{r}
mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(mouse)
```

# Conclusion
The brain with the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain is the human, with 430 genes.
